title: Pin owner reachability in the observation missing-workdir positive control
outcome: Strengthen closing_missing_workdir_does_not_inherit_enclosing_repository_refusal so its enclosing-root positive control directly proves the source owner ran before the missing-directory negative control.
acceptance: The existing enclosing-root control asserts its owner capture count, the missing-directory capture returns unavailable without increasing it, and nested-root and subdirectory controls still succeed.
